concepts.gloss_en: Moses (the biblical prophet, as archetype of the true tzaddik/leader, daat, etc.)

reason_for_human: All 23 occurrences are vocalized מֹשֶׁה/משֶׁה (Moshe) and refer to the biblical Moses — consistently as an archetype/bechina (daat, mashiach, true leader, ne'vuah, etc.). No homograph here; the מ-שׁ-ה form only ever denotes Moses in these proofs (defective משׁה vs plene מֹשֶׁה is mere spelling variation of the same name). Single concept.
